newsitem.title: FRANCE: Societe Generale targets higher EPS.
newsitem.headline: Societe Generale targets higher EPS.

text.p: French bank Societe Generale will strive to improve earnings per share over the next three years, its chairman said in an interview with the newspaper Ouest-France.
"We have decided to sharply improve our earnings per share over the next three years. After strengthening equity to some 55 billion francs, this becomes possible," Marc Vienot said.
Vienot also confirmed Societe Generale was still interested in acquiring the CIC bank.
He also said the bank's efforts to land new accounts (100,000 each year) "will continue at the same pace in 1997."
